summary: Prepare the v0.1.5 candidate from merge 2c53a55: promote all Unreleased entries with F07, version CLI/package/metadata, run local-checks in macOS smoke only, and refresh owner-authorized historical bindings and template cleanup. Independent review is next; no PR, merge or publication.

read_first.why: Release scope, decisions and review base
Promoted release notes and pinned upstream versions

decisions.decision: Keep v0.1.5 preparation in the quick lane
decisions.rationale: The requester chose v0.1.5 and macOS smoke coverage for the existing local-checks suite. This release only versions existing CLI behavior and changes test selection on macOS, with no new user-facing behavior or public contract. Base origin/main is merge 2c53a55; v0.1.4 is the latest published release. No feature tasks.md exists for this release-only lane; feature analyze does not apply. Independent review follows work, before any PR or publication. Release preparation is authorized, not merge, tag, workflow dispatch or release publication.

decisions.decision: Preregister v0.1.5 acceptance before editing release subjects
decisions.rationale: AC1: Move all and only the current Unreleased entries into a dated 0.1.5 section, add a faithful F07 POSIX bounded reap/Darwin EPERM note, retain an empty Unreleased heading and accurate unchanged/upgraded upstream pins and comparison links. Preserve historical 0.1.4 notes. AC2: Every current 0.1.4 package/CLI/test version surface and generated manifest/lock/bundle/sidecar reports 0.1.5, with historic fixtures untouched. AC3: The macOS smoke job alone adds test/unit/local-checks.test.mjs to its existing node --test selector; other OS jobs, source guard and action SHAs unchanged. AC4: Targeted local-checks/init/update and smoke-selector checks pass. AC5: npm run build, manifest and sync produce fresh metadata with upstream versions/commits/trees/file hashes unchanged from base; bundle SHA matches sidecar, size below 450 KiB, and build --check passes. AC6: release.yml tag/package and changelog guards reproduced, git diff --check and scoped/global baton validate pass, and one final npm run check passes through work write. AC7: No credentials, feed configuration, machine paths, merge, tag, release, PR or workflow dispatch. AC8: Fresh release-015 records are covered by template cleanup if the owner authorizes the bound a7 refresh; any historic release-014 CHANGELOG binding refresh requires separate owner authorization and its CLI-required gate.

decisions.decision: Record owner-authorized historical binding updates without changing historical release claims
decisions.rationale: The repository owner explicitly authorized via control-plane delegation a metadata-only release-014 CHANGELOG binding refresh for the 0.1.5 promotion/F07 note; CLI handoff refresh added D19 while leaving release-014's prior gate pending and its 0.1.4 section unchanged. In a separate owner decision via the same channel, they authorized the release-015 template-cleanup.yml entries, metadata-only release-records-docs-a7 binding refresh and renewed a7 gate; supported CLI refresh and approve recorded D22 and repository owner via control-plane delegation, without editing a7's subject or prior decisions. The CLI's schema-bounded 20-entry history trims its oldest entries; those remain in git history. No release-015 review or publication approval is implied.

AC1: all preexisting Unreleased bullets remain in the dated 2026-11-05 0.1.5 section, 0.1.4 historical section is byte-identical, F07 wording matches src/lib/local-checks.mjs and feature 004 D41/D48; comparison links and lock's peeled 1.3.0 commit match. AC2: src/cli, report, doctor, adopt, init and sync; package and lock roots; version-bound init/update expectations; generated manifest and lock now report 0.1.5. AC3: only the macOS smoke scenario command gained test/unit/local-checks.test.mjs; an existing maintainer-workflows test pins macOS-only inclusion, unconditional execution, unchanged source guard and SHA-pinned actions. AC4: initial focused test run passed 87/88 with the lone version-bound init regex expecting 0.1.4; updated it to 0.1.5 and reran all three affected test names with 3/3 pass. AC5: npm run build generated a 431965-byte bundle (<460800); raw SHA-256 02960c63952c11345410fe1a0004bc36e4867fae6ad9fc81349cced84f1c5acc equals sidecar; manifest, sync, build --check and lock verify passed. A comparison of lock upstreams/files against HEAD is identical. AC6: global validate passed with advisory recommended-pack/quick-size warnings; no approval, merge or publication was inferred. The first build and targeted tests failed for missing Node dependencies; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund restored 92 packages. Final configured check remains for the work write.

risks.text: The macOS runner can exercise the real Darwin process-group behavior only after a separately approved tag or workflow dispatch; local Linux tests cover injected-dependency paths.
